disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 排查了全部源码、构建产物、脚本与文档中是否存在读取 API Key、令牌、私钥、云凭据或钱包助记词等敏感信息的代码路径：未检出。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code, build artifacts, scripts, and documentation for code paths that read sensitive information such as API keys, tokens, private keys, cloud credentials, or wallet mnemonics: not detected.

checked_items.zh: 排查了是否访问 DSH 宿主凭据文件、SSH 私钥目录等敏感路径：未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked for access to DSH host credential files, SSH private key directories, and other sensitive paths: not detected.

checked_items.zh: 核查了生成型工作流脚本的沙箱策略：静态禁止访问进程、文件系统、网络等能力，脚本无法触碰宿主凭据。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the sandbox policy for generative workflow scripts: static policy denies access to processes, filesystem, network, and other capabilities; scripts cannot touch host credentials.

evidence.zh: 未检出任何读取宿主凭据或敏感路径的代码；生成脚本的静态策略拒绝文件系统与网络访问，凭据读取面不成立。
evidence.en: No code reading host credentials or sensitive paths detected; the generative script's static policy denies filesystem and network access, so the credential-reading surface does not hold.

checked_items.zh: 逐一审查了插件注册的三个模型工具（workflow_list、run_workflow、workflow_manage）的描述与参数说明：均为功能说明，无系统指令、无凭据诱导、无安装诱导措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the descriptions and parameter inline help of the three model tools registered by the plugin (workflow_list, run_workflow, workflow_manage) one by one: they are all functional descriptions, with no system instructions, no credential solicitation, and no installation-solicitation wording.

checked_items.zh: 审查了注入系统提示的片段（工具使用策略）：内容为引导模型合理使用 workflow 功能，无指令覆写或权限绕过措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the injected system prompt fragment (tool usage policy): its content guides the model to use the workflow functionality properly, with no instruction-override or privilege-bypass wording.

checked_items.zh: 全树未发现 AGENTS.md、SKILL.md、CLAUDE.md 等模型指令文件；文档与注释中未发现忽略指令、伪装系统消息等注入文本。
checked_items.en: No model instruction files such as AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, or CLAUDE.md found in the entire tree; no injected text such as ignoring instructions or masquerading as system messages found in documentation or comments.

evidence.zh: 三个工具描述与系统提示片段经逐条语义审查，未见指令注入、凭据读取诱导或越权措辞（工具定义位于入口文件）。
evidence.en: The three tool descriptions and the system prompt fragment were reviewed semantically item by item: no instruction injection, credential-reading solicitation, or privilege-escalation wording found (tool definitions are located in the entry file).

evidence.zh: 工具描述与命令帮助文本中未发现诱导安装插件、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；命令确认文案为常规审批提示。
evidence.en: No wording in tool descriptions or command help text that solicits installing plugins, rewriting configuration, or relaxing permissions; command confirmation copy is a standard approval prompt.

checked_items.zh: 静态扫描命中的 10 处子进程相关代码（规则 DSH-X03，对应报告规则 DG-R3-55）逐一核查：入口与引擎中的调用仅用于以固定参数执行 git 命令（diff/status/rev-parse），目标路径经逃逸校验且不经 shell；策略文件中的引用属于禁止生成脚本使用子进程的静态清单；其余为开发脚本与测试基建。全部判定为良性，不构成任意命令执行面。
checked_items.en: The 10 subprocess-related code hits from static scanning (rule DSH-X03, corresponding to report rule DG-R3-55) were reviewed one by one: calls in the entry and engine are used only to execute git commands with fixed arguments (diff/status/rev-parse), target paths pass escape validation and do not go through the shell; references in the policy file belong to the static list that forbids generative scripts from using subprocesses; the rest are development scripts and test infrastructure. All are judged benign and do not constitute an arbitrary command execution surface.

checked_items.zh: 生成型工作流脚本运行在 QuickJS WebAssembly 独立沙箱中，静态策略拒绝 import/require、process、文件系统、shell、网络、eval/Function 等能力，并有内存、栈与超时上限；node:vm 仅用于编译期语法检查，不执行脚本。
checked_items.en: Generative workflow scripts run in an isolated QuickJS WebAssembly sandbox; the static policy denies import/require, process, filesystem, shell, network, eval/Function, and other capabilities, with memory, stack, and timeout limits; node:vm is used only for compile-time syntax checking and does not execute scripts.

checked_items.zh: patch 文件仅声明插件 id，不含可执行标量；package.json 无安装钩子脚本。
checked_items.en: The patch file only declares the plugin id and contains no executable scalar; package.json has no install hook scripts.

checked_items.zh: 全树未检出 eval/new Function 任意执行、base64 动态解码执行或混淆代码；构建产物为 TypeScript 编译输出，与源码一致。
checked_items.en: No eval/new Function arbitrary execution, base64 dynamic decode-and-execute, or obfuscated code detected in the entire tree; build artifacts are TypeScript compilation output consistent with source code.

evidence.zh: patch 文件仅插入插件 id，不含可执行标量，不存在 patch 即执行面。
evidence.en: The patch file only inserts the plugin id and contains no executable scalar; there is no patch-as-execution surface.

evidence.zh: 未调用 cordis_define/cordis_run 等动态宿主执行工具；生成脚本在 QuickJS 沙箱中受限运行，宿主仅暴露 JSON 能力 RPC。
evidence.en: No dynamic host execution tools such as cordis_define/cordis_run are called; generative scripts run restricted in the QuickJS sandbox, and the host exposes only JSON capability RPC.

evidence.zh: package.json 无 preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare 安装钩子；树内无 husky、workflow、devcontainer 等执行载体。
evidence.en: package.json has no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare install hooks; no execution carriers such as husky, workflow, or devcontainer exist in the tree.

evidence.zh: 未声明 dsh.client，无浏览器端自动加载面。
evidence.en: dsh.client is not declared, so there is no browser-side auto-load surface.

checked_items.zh: 排查了全部源码、脚本与文档中的外联通道：未检出 fetch、HTTP 客户端、WebSocket 或 curl/wget 等网络外发代码；插件本体无任何出站网络能力。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code, scripts, and documentation for outbound channels: no network exfiltration code such as fetch, HTTP clients, WebSocket, or curl/wget detected; the plugin itself has no outbound network capability.

checked_items.zh: 生成型工作流脚本的静态策略显式拒绝网络能力，沙箱内无网络对象。
checked_items.en: The generative workflow script's static policy explicitly denies network capability, and the sandbox contains no network objects.

evidence.zh: 插件无网络外发面，且生成脚本被禁止联网；凭据外泄通道（读取+外联）两段均不成立。
evidence.en: The plugin has no network exfiltration surface, and generative scripts are forbidden from going online; both halves of the credential exfiltration channel (read + outbound) do not hold.

checked_items.zh: patch 文件仅插入插件 id，未触碰 sandbox/approval/permission 等安全配置行，无禁用配置，无环境变量降权写法。
checked_items.en: The patch file only inserts the plugin id and does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox/approval/permission; no disabling configuration and no environment-variable privilege-downgrade writing.

checked_items.zh: 未发现对安全事件（工具预执行、审批请求）的截断监听；未改写 inject/intercept 配置。
checked_items.en: No hooked listeners for security events (tool pre-execution, approval requests) found; no rewriting of inject/intercept configuration.

checked_items.zh: 依赖面：运行时仅 quickjs-emscripten（固定版本）；peer 依赖全部为 @deepseek-ai/* rc.2 版本；无 git 依赖、无未锁版本的可变引用、无仿冒包名迹象。README 安装示例使用浮动分支 #main 属文档建议，市场安装命令为 commit 锁定。
checked_items.en: Dependency surface: only quickjs-emscripten at runtime (fixed version); all peer dependencies are @deepseek-ai/* rc.2 versions; no git dependencies, no unlocked-version mutable references, and no signs of package-name impersonation. The README install example uses a floating branch #main, which is a documentation suggestion; the market install command is commit-locked.

checked_items.zh: 仓库与包名一致，无仿冒官方名称迹象；此为首版审计，无版本基线可比对。
checked_items.en: The repository and package name are consistent, with no signs of impersonating an official name; this is the first audit, so there is no version baseline for comparison.

evidence.zh: patch 未覆盖任何安全行，无禁用审批或沙箱的配置。
evidence.en: The patch does not cover any security lines; there is no configuration disabling approval or sandbox.

evidence.zh: 未注册任何对审批链或工具预执行事件的高优监听，不存在截断审批链的代码。
evidence.en: No high-priority listeners are registered for approval-chain or tool pre-execution events; there is no code that truncates the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首版审计，无上一版本基线，无法比较能力声明突变。
evidence.en: First audit, no previous version baseline, so capability-declaration mutations cannot be compared.

evidence.zh: patch 未改写 inject/intercept，不存在对安全插件的必需服务篡改。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite inject/intercept; there is no tampering with required services of security plugins.

checked_items.zh: 插件未启动任何 Web 服务或监听端口，不存在本机无认证 RPC 面。
checked_items.en: The plugin starts no web services and listens on no ports; there is no unauthenticated local RPC surface.

checked_items.zh: 运行面核查：工作流引擎在宿主进程内运行，但生成脚本隔离于 QuickJS 沙箱；可信本地脚本需一次性显式确认；审批与权限门禁沿用 DSH 宿主机制。
checked_items.en: Runtime surface check: the workflow engine runs in the host process, but generative scripts are isolated in the QuickJS sandbox; trusted local scripts require one-time explicit confirmation; approval and permission gates follow the DSH host mechanism.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动 Web 服务、不监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin starts no web services and listens on no ports; the unauthenticated local RPC scenario is not applicable.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核验通过：dsh.bundle.patch 声明存在，patch 最小，无名称仿冒迹象。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: dsh.bundle.patch is declared, the patch is minimal, and there are no signs of name impersonation.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：10 处子进程相关命中（规则 DSH-X03/DG-R3-55）全部核查为 git 只读调用或受限脚本策略清单，未构成任意命令执行面。
summary.en: Static scan completed: all 10 subprocess-related hits (rules DSH-X03/DG-R3-55) were reviewed and are git read-only calls or restricted script policy lists; they do not constitute an arbitrary command execution surface.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：无安装钩子、无外联通道、无凭据读取、无混淆代码。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis passed: no install hooks, no outbound channels, no credential reading, and no obfuscated code.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：工具描述与系统提示片段无注入措辞，能力声明与代码一致。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: tool descriptions and system prompt fragments contain no injection wording, and capability declarations are consistent with code.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed in this stage.

limits.zh: 插件无显式能力清单，declared_capabilities 为依据代码推断：network=false、shell=false（仅内置 review 功能以固定参数调用 git 子进程）、fs=write、modelFacing=true。未做动态沙箱验证（无动态沙箱产物）。README 安装示例使用浮动分支 #main 属文档建议，市场安装命令为 commit 锁定，未作为独立发现收录。
limits.en: The plugin has no explicit capability list; declared_capabilities are inferred from code: network=false, shell=false (only the built-in review feature calls the git subprocess with fixed arguments), fs=write, modelFacing=true. No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no dynamic sandbox artifacts). The README install example uses a floating branch #main, which is a documentation suggestion; the market install command is commit-locked, so it was not recorded as a standalone finding.
